test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank:

Had I known the conference was postponed, I ______ my flight reservations.
solution:
The correct answer is '**would have canceled**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The sentence is an example of the **third conditional**, which is used to describe hypothetical situations in the past.
 
• The structure of the third conditional is **If + past perfect, would have + past participle**.
 
• The phrase "**Had I known**" is equivalent to "**If I had known**" and sets the condition in the past.
 
• The result clause requires the correct form of the verb, which is "**would have canceled**" to match the hypothetical past situation.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Had I known the conference was postponed, I **would have canceled**__ my flight reservations."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "would cancel"** is incorrect because it is used for hypothetical situations in the present or future, not the past.
 
• **Option 3: "will have canceled"** is incorrect because "will" implies future action, which does not fit the past hypothetical context.
 
• **Option 4: "had canceled"** is incorrect because it does not align with the third conditional structure.
